reviewNote: Adopt the internal portions of the transverse white-matter band traced from its midline anterior-commissural crossing into the bilateral inferolateral arms. Root reviewed all 59 registered300 candidate planes (12 coronal, 36 sagittal, 11 axial) and 18 native100 sheets / 54 planes. Supplementary native references corrected left arm Z130, central posterior edge Y271, and right arm [229,272,128]. Location, neighboring structures and multiplanar course support anterior commissure; brightness, coordinate envelope and connectivity were not sufficient identity criteria. Two central posterior-edge cells [196,271,135] and [198,271,135] are withheld because their 0.5 mm support approaches the high-resolution tissue/fluid edge; actual native center/eight-corner values also flag partial volume. All other reviewed 416 explicit cells retain internal tissue support. Existing labels 31/32 in the lateral course are not overwritten merely to connect the tract.
limitation: Partial internal core only, not the full tract contour or temporal terminations. Six disconnected components are retained without filling or smoothing; current internal-capsule overlap and thin lateral intervals remain unresolved. No expert validation or quiz eligibility.
